description_en: Queries the machine list settings for vulnerability scanning
description_zh: 查询开启漏洞扫描的机器列表设置
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-target --type vul --config vulType_:_cms --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTarget

parameters.help_en: The query type. Set this parameter to vul
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:

cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cve: Linux software vulnerability
emg: emergency vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值为：

cms  Web-CMS漏洞
sys    Windows系统漏洞
cve    Linux软件漏洞
emg   应急漏洞
parameters.name: config

Targets.description_en: The machine settings for the vulnerability type
Targets.description_zh: 漏洞类型对应的机器设置

Flag.description_en: The flag. This parameter can be empty

Target.description_en: The target. The value is a machine UUID or a machine group ID

TargetType.description_en:
The target type. Valid values:

uuid: added by individual asset
groupId: added by server group
TargetType.description_zh:
目标类型。取值为：

uuid：按单个资产添加
groupId：按照服务器分组添加

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of machine configuration entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的机器配置信息总数量
